pull_request.body:
## Summary

- Extend the existing SANA convolution post-processing kernels to NCHW and to an already-biased GLU input; use them in SANA-WM's spatial FFN.
- Traverse streaming's exclusive backward GDN recurrence directly in reverse frame order, removing full-video flip/shift/cat intermediates. Preserve the forward recurrence and carried state.
- Verify each supported signature against the original implementation before enabling the path; fall back on mismatch, JIT failure, gradients, compilation, or unverified graph capture.
- Add convolution rounding, streaming state, changed-input graph replay, and fallback tests.

## H200 results

Setup: **1x H200**, PyTorch `2.11.0+cu130`, native `SanaWMTwoStagePipeline`, 1280x704, 49 requested frames, 16 fps, seed 42. Prompt: `a camera moving forward and turning left`; input: the SANA-WM cat image, camera actions `w-16,wl-16,l-16`. Bidirectional uses 20 main denoise steps and guidance 4.5; streaming uses its native preset with `--streaming --refiner-chunked`.

Each quality mode uses fresh processes in **A-B-B-A** order on the same GPU, with request warmup and output saving. E2E is the SGLang perf dump's `total_duration_ms`, not process startup time; loading, warmup, and profiled requests are excluded. The main-denoise metric excludes the refiner and decoding stages.

The measured baseline was `77fb7a72889a7155b0af34739a409d4517219530`, with candidates `f49ed7f8edfdb6053ce8b0bbe59e4e143f332a7e` (bidirectional) and `00a7c22370aa8d3483b0f3e5d3c1be05f86144c0` (streaming). This PR is rebased onto `482e9f257bb9d9ac57c2245c93768a96ec70edbe`. The kernel and recurrence arithmetic match the measured implementation; the rebase adds only lazy facade lookup after the CUDA guard and formatting to the model code. The E2E numbers below were collected on the recorded benchmark commits, not rerun on the rebased PR; unrelated pipeline changes between those bases may affect absolute latency.

### Eager end-to-end

| Model | Quality | Baseline runs | PR runs | Mean latency reduction |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Bidirectional | lossless | 11.284110 / 11.401986 s | 10.886620 / 10.984227 s | **3.594%** |
| Bidirectional | high | 11.218915 / 11.249977 s | 10.882883 / 10.880532 s | **3.140%** |
| Streaming | lossless | 4.031260 / 3.976402 s | 3.901933 / 3.915875 s | **2.371%** |
| Streaming | high | 4.110855 / 3.978998 s | 4.009085 / 3.891730 s | **2.337%** |

### Main denoise stage

| Model | Quality | Baseline runs | PR runs | Mean latency reduction |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Bidirectional | lossless | 9.321119 / 9.291558 s | 8.944371 / 8.953174 s | 3.842% |
| Bidirectional | high | 9.288189 / 9.293075 s | 8.943616 / 8.946158 s | 3.721% |
| Streaming | lossless | 1.683968 / 1.663815 s | 1.555888 / 1.546329 s | 7.335% |
| Streaming | high | 1.664033 / 1.658613 s | 1.667980 / 1.529492 s | 3.767% |

Both high streaming samples are retained despite larger variation. Convolution-only streaming improved E2E by just 0.408%; its final result above includes the reverse-scan optimization. Bidirectional peak reserved memory is 79.139 -> 79.133 GiB; streaming fits within 87.289 GiB. GPU allocation snapshots found no extra process on the measured GPU during the final matrices; these are sampled checks, not continuous exclusivity guarantees.

### Breakable CUDA Graph

Both native SANA-WM presets were actually launched with BCG requested. The pipeline support gate logged `[Diffusion BCG] disabled`; there was no capture. The eager fallback timings are excluded. Kernel-level graph replay tests pass, but this PR makes no model-level BCG performance claim.

### Kernel and profile evidence

The initial trace exposed repeated conv bias/SiLU and GLU chains. The convolution experiment preserved all BF16 intermediate rounding. Extracting the depthwise convolution bias caused 45,490,650 mismatched elements out of 165,580,800, so the final implementation keeps that native biased convolution intact.

| Profile-shaped experiment | Original | Candidate | Scope |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| 1x1 conv + bias + SiLU, input `[14,2240,22,40]` | 3.3192 ms | 2.8615 ms | Full conv sequence |
| GLU after biased depthwise, input `[14,13440,22,40]` | 0.4313 ms | 0.1183 ms | Post-processing only |
| Main cached GDN, 4 frames, contiguous D/N | 1.4480 ms | 1.0153 ms | Full forward + backward recurrence |
| Camera cached GDN, 4 frames, contiguous D/N | 1.0928 ms | 0.7887 ms | Full forward + backward recurrence |

The [original microbenchmark scripts and raw results](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/tree/pr-media/diffusion-prs/sana-wm-conv-gdn-h200) are included. These CUDA-graph device microbenchmarks are prototype measurements used to choose the edit, separate from the native eager request measurements above. GDN uses `[B,H,D,S]=[1,20,112,880]`, FP32; convolution uses BF16.

Paired full-stage profiles confirm the mechanism in the actual model:

| Main-denoise profile | Baseline | PR |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Bidirectional kernel launches | 92,068 | 91,268 |
| Bidirectional cumulative kernel time | 9,276.882 ms | 8,929.363 ms |
| Streaming kernel launches | 79,555 | 70,755 |
| Streaming cumulative kernel time | 1,557.402 ms | 1,433.840 ms |
| Streaming flip kernels | 2,850 | 600 |
| Streaming copy kernels | 14,531 | 13,031 |
| Streaming cat kernels | 2,589 | 1,989 |

Bidirectional adds 400 fused bias-SiLU calls (71.440 ms total) and 400 GLU calls (45.299 ms). Streaming removes 400 post-convolution launches plus 8,400 reverse-scan launches. Native depthwise counts are unchanged (1,600 bidirectional, 800 streaming), as are other-stage kernel counts. Cumulative kernel time is diagnostic, not wall-clock E2E.

## Output comparison

All eight formal videos for **each** model are byte-identical across lossless/high and baseline/PR. Independently decoded frames have **SSIM 1.0 and zero pixel error**. Bidirectional saves 48 frames because the refiner removes the first sink anchor; streaming saves 49 frames.

| Model | Full baseline video | Full PR video | SHA256 shared by all 8 formal outputs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bidirectional | [MP4](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/pr-media/diffusion-prs/sana-wm-conv-gdn-h200/bidirectional-baseline.mp4) | [MP4](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/pr-media/diffusion-prs/sana-wm-conv-gdn-h200/bidirectional-pr.mp4) | `706642d6d8daf304f0a3ca5d7aaa94b88841e1d9a686f151143ddeedff5f272d` |
| streaming | [MP4](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/pr-media/diffusion-prs/sana-wm-conv-gdn-h200/streaming-baseline.mp4) | [MP4](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/pr-media/diffusion-prs/sana-wm-conv-gdn-h200/streaming-pr.mp4) | `433929d59ec7efec9b566218e63896b5ebfd732f08b8978e2f9e586d0394686f` |

Bidirectional frame comparison (baseline above, PR below):

![Bidirectional baseline and PR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/pr-media/diffusion-prs/sana-wm-conv-gdn-h200/bidirectional-comparison.jpg)

Streaming frame comparison (baseline above, PR below):

![Streaming baseline and PR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/pr-media/diffusion-prs/sana-wm-conv-gdn-h200/streaming-comparison.jpg)

[All 16 individual measurements and output hashes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/pr-media/diffusion-prs/sana-wm-conv-gdn-h200/benchmark-results.json).

## Reproduce

Run each command on the baseline and PR with `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` selecting one idle H200, for each of `--quality=lossless` and `--quality=high`. `cat.png` is the SANA-WM benchmark image (SHA256 `b3596420d2f0bdf3122f04c89b550d7ff504045312b6b1e075a0c2841531543d`).

```bash
SGLANG_DIFFUSION_SYNC_STAGE_PROFILING=1 sglang generate \
  --backend=sglang --model-path Efficient-Large-Model/SANA-WM_bidirectional \
  --pipeline-class-name=SanaWMTwoStagePipeline \
  --prompt 'a camera moving forward and turning left' --image-path cat.png \
  --width=1280 --height=704 --num-frames=49 --fps=16 --seed=42 \
  --num-inference-steps=20 --guidance-scale=4.5 --action=w-16,wl-16,l-16 \
  --performance-mode=manual --quality=lossless --warmup-mode=request \
  --save-output --perf-dump-path bidirectional.json

SGLANG_DIFFUSION_SYNC_STAGE_PROFILING=1 sglang generate \
  --backend=sglang --model-path Efficient-Large-Model/SANA-WM_streaming \
  --pipeline-class-name=SanaWMTwoStagePipeline --streaming --refiner-chunked \
  --prompt 'a camera moving forward and turning left' --image-path cat.png \
  --width=1280 --height=704 --num-frames=49 --fps=16 --seed=42 \
  --action=w-16,wl-16,l-16 --performance-mode=manual \
  --quality=lossless --warmup-mode=request --save-output --perf-dump-path streaming.json
```

Add `--profile --profile-all-stages` for separate diagnostic runs. Add `--enable-breakable-cuda-graph --warmup-resolutions 1280x704 --warmup-num-frames 49` to reproduce the native BCG support check.

## Validation

- Final rebased head `8218a2455f4100ba3d87edbadf631707431e1988`: **9 H200 tests passed** (5 convolution + 4 reverse-scan), with an idle-GPU precheck.
- Full pre-commit on all four changed files and `git diff --check`: passed.

- Original measured commits: 5 convolution tests and 4 reverse-scan tests passed on H200, plus 24 exact GDN prototype output/state checks.
- Covers both convolution layouts/bias modes, real convolution rounding, multiple GDN chunks and beta layouts, updated graph inputs and carried states, unverified capture, mismatch fallback, autograd fallback, and nonfinite queries.
- Model weight cleanup verified zero remaining task-owned files/bytes/weights after each model: bidirectional 215,530,433,392 ledger bytes / 1,115 weight files -> 0; streaming 187,560,006,533 bytes / 22 weight files -> 0. The ledger counts cache hardlinks, not unique physical storage.
